get.description: Poll an async job and read its result once it completes. See [Rate Limits](/api-reference/rate-limits#status-polling) for the polling budget.

200.description: Current async job status. Completed enrichment jobs include the result under `result`.

run_id.description: The ID of this execution of the job. Refer to the job by `id`.

progress.description: Bulk runs only: rows enriched so far out of the total rows submitted.

investigation.description:
The Atlas investigation a run belongs to: its ID and a link to open it in
the Sixtyfour app. Its files, findings and graph are served by the /v1/atlas
endpoints.

workspace_url.description: Canonical Sixtyfour app URL for the investigation's Atlas workspace.
workspace_url.title: Workspace Url

investigation.title: InvestigationReference

run_id.description: The ID of this execution of the job. Refer to the job by `id`.

result.description: Completed job result. Shape depends on task_type.

structured_data.description: Requested enrichment fields and extracted values.
structured_data.title: Structured Data

confidence_score.description: Overall confidence in the result, from 0 (nothing useful found) to 10 (every field filled and cross-checked).
confidence_score.title: Confidence Score

references.description: Source references used to produce the result.
references.title: References

notes.description: Human-readable notes about the enrichment result.
notes.title: Notes

findings.description: Optional supporting findings produced by the enrichment agent.
findings.title: Findings

field_confidence.description: Per requested field, nested like the request: its confidence (0-100), justification and sources. xHigh also names the research graph nodes the value rests on.
field_confidence.title: Field Confidence

investigation_id.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Use the response envelope's `investigation.id`.
investigation_id.title: Investigation Id

anyOf.description: Result of a contact lookup or another job without `struct`.
Array result for jobs that return multiple rows or records inline.

charge_amount.description: Deprecated. Use `charge_credits`. The same amount in tenths of a credit.

get.description:
Server-Sent Events: the agents' turn summaries as they are written.

Frames:
- `sessions`: every agent session; sent first and on each change.
- `event`: one turn summary; its `id:` is the resume cursor.
- `status`: the investigation's status, on open and on each change.
- `end`: the run finished and every event was sent. The `sessions` frame before it carries the run's cost,
  `null` until the charge is recorded.
- `access_lost`: you can no longer see the investigation.

The stream closes after about five minutes; reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` or `after` to resume. Comment lines
keep the connection open.
